W.note: Clean, cheap, accessible dark pill with a faint sheen and glow, but the hover is quick and subtle so it reads as polite rather than dreamlike.

X.note: Pastel iridescent gradient drifting with a rotating sparkle and soft glow feels ethereal, with legible dark label, focus ring and reduced-motion fallback.

Y.note: Solid, performant button with a light pass and glow arriving on a lingering tail, but visually a conventional purple CTA with limited ethereal quality.

Z.note: Colour-shifting aurora, rising motes and slow overshoot-and-fade exhale are the most dreamlike, though the white resting button has weaker affordance and the 1.4s timings are long.
